name: random-field Ising antiferromagnet in a staggered field
question: Does the same antiferromagnet return to its configuration when the field has opposite signs on the two sublattices?
assumptions: The couplings and random fields of the antiferromagnet in a uniform field
The field acts with opposite signs on the two sublattices of the square lattice
The field changes slowly; thermal activation is neglected

provenance.source: model; relabeling one sublattice maps it onto the ferromagnet in a uniform field
